requirements.text: The Retirement & Goals section shall add the bullet "<Company> vests: $<X> after estimated tax ($<Y> before tax) between <first date> and <last date>, at the <analysis date> price."

tests.title: Retirement & Goals bullet with the price date, and the sell-or-keep note
a PSU vest shows the target figure with its range

requirements.text: Where a goal's year falls on or after a vest, the system shall add "Vests before <goal> (<year>): $<X> after estimated tax."

tests.title: vests before the goal: both years, after tax ($80K before tax)
a goal before the first vest gets no line

requirements.text: The system shall add to the vest bullets "Value on the vest date; whether shares are sold or kept is the client's decision."

tests.title: Retirement & Goals bullet with the price date, and the sell-or-keep note

requirements.text: If the household has no complete grant of a listed employer, then the system shall show the projection, the goal markers and the Retirement & Goals section exactly as today.

tests.title: no complete listed grant: projection and goals as today

requirements.text: The projection shall count each vest once, as the inflow of AC-D-01, and not again through the year's income; after its vest date it shall project the after-tax amount as the platform projects cash savings.

tests.title: each vest enters once, after tax, then grows as cash savings

requirements.text: When an analysis with vest inflows is shared, the system shall record whether any F-D line was edited or deleted before sharing.
Where the firm has enabled stock compensation, the Income section shall offer a "Stock compensation" chip among "other current income".
Where the firm has enabled stock compensation, the system shall show under the employment income field the helper line "Paid partly in company stock? Add it below as Stock compensation."

When the client selects the chip, the system shall add a row with: owner (one person), employer, ticker if listed (security search), type (RSU, PSU, other, not sure), approximate value of unvested stock, how often it vests (monthly, quarterly, every six months, yearly, not sure); each selection adds one row, as for other chips.

tests.title: client and co-client with the same employer: two rows, two grants, one employer
a private employer (no ticker) is recorded as not listed

requirements.text: The system shall require the employer in each row and accept "not sure" or empty for every other field.

tests.title: only the employer is required; every other field may be empty or "not sure"

requirements.text: The system shall ask in each row "Does your employment income above include stock that vested this year?" (yes, no, not sure).
If the client adds no stock compensation row, then the system shall continue the questionnaire exactly as today.

tests.title: no row: the household and its analysis are exactly as today

requirements.text: When the questionnaire is submitted with a row, the system shall create a grant for that person with status "pending detail" and source "questionnaire".

tests.title: submitting a row creates a grant pending detail, source questionnaire, with the client estimate

requirements.text: While a grant is pending detail, the opportunity shall show the alert "Stock pay: detail pending".

tests.title: the alert shows while a grant is pending and goes when none is

requirements.text: When no grant of the household is pending detail, the system shall remove the alert.

tests.title: the alert shows while a grant is pending and goes when none is

requirements.text: While a grant is pending detail, the analysis shall show "<Name> reported pay in <company> stock. It is not yet included in these figures."

Where the answer to AC-E-05 is yes, the system shall add no income for tranches dated in the current year, and from the next year use as salary the reported income minus the current year's vest value.

tests.title: "yes": nothing added this year; from next year salary is reported income minus this year's vests
with "income includes vests", this year's total income equals reported income (see F-C, AC-E-11)

requirements.text: Where the answer to AC-E-05 is no, the system shall add every future tranche, including those of the current year, beside the reported salary.

tests.title: "no": every future tranche, this year's included, is added beside salary

requirements.text: Where the answer to AC-E-05 is "not sure", the system shall keep the grant pending detail and show the advisor "Check whether the reported income includes stock that vested this year."

tests.title: "not sure" keeps the grant pending and tells the advisor

requirements.text: The grant editor shall show the client's answers labelled "Client estimate, not used in the figures".

tests.title: the client estimate is shown, labelled as not used in the figures

requirements.text: In advisor mode, the stock-pay block shall open the full grant editor of F-B.
Where the type is "other", the system shall show the advisor "This type is not modelled in this version; flag any shares already held as employer stock."

tests.title: type "other": advisor notice to flag held shares instead

requirements.text: When held positions have the ticker given for an employer, the system shall show the advisor one suggestion per employer naming every account that holds them: "<Company> (<ticker>) is held in <accounts>. Flag as employer stock?"

tests.title: one suggestion per employer naming every account; flagged only after the advisor confirms each position

requirements.text: The system shall flag a suggested position only after the advisor confirms.

tests.title: one suggestion per employer naming every account; flagged only after the advisor confirms each position

requirements.text: The row shall show "Upload your plan statement if you have it" with a link to the documents step; an uploaded statement enters F-F as a proposal (AC-F-13).
The system shall never block completing the questionnaire or generating the analysis because a grant is pending detail.

tests.title: a pending grant never blocks submitting or generating the analysis

requirements.text: The system shall add the chip to any Financial Health template the firm uses [ASSUMPTION: the income widget is shared by the firm's templates].
When a stock compensation row is added or removed, the system shall record it with the firm.

tests.title: adding or removing a row is recorded with the firm

requirements.text: When a questionnaire is completed, the system shall keep the stock-pay answer with the completion it already stores.

tests.title: the completion keeps the stock-pay answer

requirements.text: When the alert "Stock pay: detail pending" is raised or removed, the system shall record the time.

tests.title: the alert being raised and removed is recorded with the time

requirements.text: Where the firm has enabled stock compensation, the grant editor shall let the advisor upload a plan statement.
When a statement is uploaded, the system shall propose one grant per grant found, with its tranches, with status "proposed".

tests.title: one proposed grant per grant found: two RSU and one PSU

requirements.text: While a grant is proposed, the system shall leave it out of every figure.

tests.title: a proposed grant stays out of every figure

requirements.text: The system shall show the uploaded document next to the proposed values.
The system shall let the advisor edit any proposed field before confirming.
When the advisor confirms a proposed grant, the system shall mark it complete and reprocess the analysis.

tests.title: confirming marks the grant complete and it enters the figures

requirements.text: When the advisor rejects a proposed grant, the system shall discard it and change nothing else.

tests.title: rejecting discards the proposal and changes nothing else

requirements.text: If the extraction finds no grant, then the system shall show "No grants found in this document. Enter them by hand."

tests.title: nothing found: no proposal

requirements.text: If a proposed grant has the same employer and grant date as an existing grant, then the system shall show both and let the advisor choose which to keep.

tests.title: same employer and grant date as an existing grant: both kept until the advisor chooses

requirements.text: Where the statement shows past vests, the system shall propose them as past tranches with the prompt of AC-B-12.

tests.title: past vests are proposed as past tranches with shares kept; no held position is created

requirements.text: The system shall not create held positions from a statement.

tests.title: past vests are proposed as past tranches with shares kept; no held position is created

requirements.text: The system shall label every proposed value "Extracted from <document>, not confirmed".
When the client uploads a plan statement in the questionnaire's documents step, the system shall process it as in AC-F-02 to AC-F-12, as a proposal the advisor confirms.

tests.title: a client upload in the questionnaire becomes the same proposal for the advisor to confirm

requirements.text: When a statement is uploaded, the system shall record whether any grant was found.

tests.title: upload records whether any grant was found

requirements.text: When a proposed grant is confirmed, the system shall record how many fields the advisor changed.

tests.title: confirming records how many fields the advisor changed

requirements.text: When a proposed grant is rejected, the system shall record it.

tests.title: rejecting is recorded
